en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me me, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Sinan, from a man from the people of Hamadan named Abdullah ibn al-Dhahhak, from Abu Khalid al-Ahmar, from Abu Maryam al-Ansari that

Rasulullah (sw) said: Certainly, when the orphan cries, the Divine Throne starts to shakes for him, then the Lord Almighty says: "Who is it that made My servant cry, of whose parents I have taken during his childhood? By My might and majesty, no one will comfort him except that I will make Paradise obligatory for him."
